welcome.title: Welcome to Applyer
welcome.intro: Applyer turns a coding assistant running in the built-in terminal (Claude Code, Codex, or any other MCP-capable agent) into a job-search assistant. Here's the shape of it:
welcome.step1Body: Add your profile and resume next. This is what the agent uses to judge fit and fill out applications.
welcome.step2Title: 2. Ask the agent to find jobs.
welcome.step2Body: It searches the web and adds matches to a task board here in the app. Nothing gets submitted automatically.
welcome.step3Body: The agent can draft a filled-out application for your review, but only you ever click submit.

storage.title: How should we store your information locally?
storage.intro: Everything stays on this computer either way. This only changes how it's stored on disk.
storage.encryptedDescription: Locked using this computer's built-in secure storage, the same kind of protection your browser uses for saved passwords. Only readable on this device, by your user account.
storage.plaintextDescription: Stored as regular, readable files on this computer. Simpler to back up or inspect yourself, but readable by anyone with access to this computer's files.
storage.unavailable: Not available on this system (no OS keychain detected).

documents.title: Your documents
documents.intro: A resume is required. The agent reads these to judge fit and can attach them when filling out forms.

profileForm.title: Your profile
profileForm.intro: The agent uses this to judge job matches and fill application forms.

mcp.title: Connect your agent
mcp.intro: Applyer exposes tools (search, queue, etc.) over MCP, a standard way for coding agents to call into an app. Set this up once per agent, either automatically or by copying the command below into its config.
